# spxtacular

> Python 3.12+ mass-spectrum processing library: filtering, denoising, centroiding, isotope deconvolution, charge assignment, fragment matching, PSM scoring, spectrum similarity, chromatograms, raw-file readers (Bruker .d, mzML, Thermo .raw, MGF/MS2/MSP) and accessible plotly figures, all behind one chainable `Spectrum` object.

Methods on `Spectrum` / `MsnSpectrum` return a new object unless `inplace=True`, and the peak arrays (`mz`, `intensity`, `charge`, `im`, `iso_score`) always stay parallel. `charge > 0` is assigned, `-1` is an unassigned singleton, `0` is a neutral mass after `decharge()`. Call `deconvolute()` before `decharge()`. `Reader(path)` auto-detects the file format; readers for Bruker, mzML, Thermo and the interop/sharing bridges need optional extras (`pip install spxtacular[all]`).

spxtacular is part of tacular-omics: fragments come from `peptacular`, and the Bruker and mzML readers are built on `tdfpy` and `mzmlpy`.

## Docs

- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tacular-omics/spxtacular/main/llms-full.txt): self-contained usage guide with every public function and class, signatures, examples and gotchas
- [Documentation home](https://tacular-omics.github.io/spxtacular/): overview and quick start
- [Spectrum and MsnSpectrum](https://tacular-omics.github.io/spxtacular/spectrum/): data model and every transform
- [Deconvolution](https://tacular-omics.github.io/spxtacular/deconvolution/): algorithm, parameters, isotope and ionization models
- [Readers](https://tacular-omics.github.io/spxtacular/readers/): Bruker, mzML, Thermo, MGF/MS2/MSP, USI
- [Matching and scoring](https://tacular-omics.github.io/spxtacular/scoring/): fragment matching, hyperscore, spectral angle
- [Visualization](https://tacular-omics.github.io/spxtacular/visualization/): figures, plot tables, theme
- [README](https://github.com/tacular-omics/spxtacular/blob/main/README.md): install and quick start

## API

- [API reference](https://tacular-omics.github.io/spxtacular/api/): every public class and function
- [Source: `__init__.py`](https://github.com/tacular-omics/spxtacular/blob/main/src/spxtacular/__init__.py): the exported names
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/spxtacular/): releases and extras

## Optional

- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/tacular-omics/spxtacular/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): user-visible changes (0.7.0 changed hyperscore; old scores are not comparable)
- [Design record: polarity, adducts and isotope models](https://tacular-omics.github.io/spxtacular/design/polarity-adducts-and-isotope-roadmap/)
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/tacular-omics/spxtacular/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): guide for agents developing spxtacular itself
- [peptacular](https://github.com/tacular-omics/peptacular): peptide parsing and fragment generation used as scoring input
